qualification_cases.question: Does needs_metadata=false certify source or numeric quality?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: No. Preserve existing metadata contract; require separate source/quality checks.

qualification_cases.question: Are 1.2 trillion, 90 billion and a 33% increase mutually consistent?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: No. Arithmetic contradicts that relationship; original correct value remains unknown.

qualification_cases.question: May the system repair 90 billion to 900 billion automatically?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: No. Plausible correction is not source evidence.

qualification_cases.question: Can the two 3M columns be compared as a fixed-date revision?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: No fixed-date revision without matching target/anchor conventions; profile comparison is separately labeled.

qualification_cases.question: Is there a primary source supporting the earlier year-end level?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: Yes, an earlier original supports the old level; immediate predecessor and uninterrupted history remain unknown.

qualification_cases.question: Is September 7 a second new numerical reduction after September 3?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: Not on the inspected year-end value; same quoted change is already present earlier. Do not discard other new content automatically.

qualification_cases.question: Does September 3 prove the first ever announcement date?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: No. It is the earliest located revision in this bounded investigation, not a complete chronology.

qualification_cases.question: Are the graph forward curve and ING forecast the same observation type?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: No. Preserve series roles; do not infer exact graph numbers by eye.

qualification_cases.question: Does an upward arrow prove an upward revision?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: No. Arrow semantics need a legend or source attestation.

qualification_cases.question: Do broad website reuse terms settle the report-specific permissions?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: No. Preserve document-specific conflict and ask qualified/rightsholder clarification.

qualification_cases.question: Can public original inspection be counted as an authenticated vault/viewer proof?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: No. Vault IDs, actual source/body bytes, admission and customer journey remain unverified.

qualification_cases.question: Can these forecasts be relabeled issuer guidance to pass the old oracle?
qualification_cases.expected_answer: No. Explicit analyst-forecast handling is a required contract amendment; fixture labels confer no permissions.
